The Centre of Excellence Unmanned is dedicated in provision of COTS and services on UAV and robots. Its software EZ CHAINS is a Command and Control software that enables swarm of UAV to carry out complex mission. EZ Chains controlling the fleet of drones can also be used for Surveillance purposes, proposing significant performance enhancements, such as:
- Exploration by UAV
- Supervision
- Security and Inspection
- Cartography & Defect inspection
This software is embedded in each light UAV (<40 KG). Each unmanned system can navigate without remote control. The different drones are cooperative and have an organized mission order to create a swarm of drones. Each drone has the full mission plan, and each drone communicates with the others (4 times/ second). If a drone is out of order, another drone can replace it automatically. The software manages a safe dropping with a camera and embedded Artificial Intelligence. It is independent from hardware after a calibration phase. Tests have been performed with a payload until 9 Kg per drone, total weight of the drone being 35 Kg. Autonomy: 30 Minutes. 
SCALIAN can provide VTOL, manufactured through a China-free Supply Chain.

entityDescription: Da quando nel 1992 si è costituita, la ESSEBI opera prevalentemente nel settore dei servizi per l’ingegneria strutturale. Sua specifica competenza è l’implementazione di impianti di monitoraggio statico o dinamico, sia di strutture civili che di opere architettoniche, nonché lo svolgimento di attività di diagnostica generale, su manufatti in calcestruzzo armato e precompresso, acciaio, muratura e legno con prove e strumentazione dedicata a carattere prevalentemente non distruttivo. Precedenti esperienze in vari campi dell’ingegneria dei soci fondatori e soprattutto le loro variegate professionalità, spazianti dall’elettronica alle costruzioni civili, senza disdegnare il vasto settore delle misure meccaniche, le hanno consentito in poco tempo di occupare una posizione di preminenza in un mercato in via di consolidamento, in grado di fornire ampio spazio ad aziende flessibili e ben strutturate dal punto di vista operativo. A partire da una consolidata esperienza derivante da oltre venticinque anni di ininterrotta attività, la ESSEBI fornisce oggi un valido supporto a tutti i vari operatori del settore (liberi professionisti, società di costruzioni, sovrintendenze, pubbliche amministrazioni, amministrazioni di condominio, ecc.) che, trovandosi al cospetto di manufatti, recenti o antichi, di cui poco si conosce o che versano in uno stato di ammaloramento evidente o presunto, necessitano una diagnosi relativa alla qualità dei materiali, alla tipologia e organizzazione costruttiva, al quadro evolutivo dei dissesti esistenti o degli effetti conseguenti ai fenomeni vibratori insorti negli anni, a seguito della costante ed inevitabile evoluzione delle città, ed invecchiamento del costruito. Tale esigenza non si pone più solo per il nostro patrimonio di carattere storico e monumentale, ma sempre più frequentemente laddove s’intenda, responsabilmente e preventivamente, procedere alla sicurezza, alla difesa ed al recupero del patrimonio edilizio ed infrastrutturale esistente. In particolare gli ultimi sviluppi nell’ambito della identificazione e caratterizzazione modale delle strutture hanno consentito di dotarla di strumenti per una efficace diagnosi basata sul periodico controllo di parametri dinamici e per analisi sperimentali di vulnerabilità, di fondamentale importanza in un territorio come quello italiano in cui il rischio sismico è decisamente elevato.

entityDescription: Arcam EBM AB is a GE Additive company that develops and manufactures Additive Manufacturing systems for production of complex metal components directly from three-dimensional designs. The Additive Manufacturing process Electron Beam Meling (EBM), also known as Electron Beam- Powder Bed Fusion (EB-PBF) was originally invented by the founders of the company back in 1997. The first commercial system was delivered in 2003 and since then more than 400 systems have been installed worldwide. The company's patent portfolio consists of more than 200 patents/patent applications belonging to 56 different registered patent families of the Electron Beam Melting technology. Arcam EBM is today the world leader in offering systems for Electron Beam – Powder Bed Fusion process.In the Arcam Electron Beam Melting process fully dense metal components are built up, layer-by-layer of metal powder, melted by a powerful electron beam. Electron Beam Melting makes it possible to manufacture metal components with optimal properties in small and medium volumes. Orthopedic implant manufacturers utilize the technology’s potential in cost-effective manufacturing of products with advanced functionality and increasingly the aerospace industry has been building up knowledge, resources and expertise in readiness to use EBM manufacture.Arcam EBM was acquired by General Electric in December 2017 and is now a part of the GE Additive company ecosystem. Arcam EBM as an entity has more than 240 employees in Mölnycke, Sweden. Here, development and production of the EBM systems is conducted. The company today offers five different Electron Beam Melting platforms for various industry segments capable of producing various metallic materials. Apart from the EBM systems, Arcam does also offer surrounding equipment, materials, services and training for customers to facilitate full industrial production.

KALOMA SA was founded in 1998. It was then licensed for 150 tons of production (sea bream, sea bass, etc.). The unit is located in the Sagiada Strip, in the northern part of Thesprotia in a sea area of ​​15 acres (1.5 hectares). From October 2018 in SKALOMA the position of "Ormos Orlias" with an area of ​​15 acres was annexed.
The current production amounts to 590 tons per year - TSIPOURA - LAVRAKI - KRANIOS - MYTAKI - FAGRI. It is certified with HACCP and ISO. It standardizes and packs its fish in a also certified packaging plant while most of the production is exported to Italy, Spain, England, USA and Canada.
Research interests
SKALOMA SA implemented the SEA-On-A-Chip research project, funded by the HORIZON program. The object of the project was to create an integrated sensor that operates automatically and has the ability to perform biochemical analyzes in the marine environment, detecting potential biochemical contaminants that could threaten aquaculture, sending wireless data and alerts. The project was successfully completed in May 2017. The unit carried out the experimental application of the integrated sensor.
Today he implements the research project SEAFOODTOMORROW (HORIZON 2020). The object of the project is to enrich the fish through their food with ingredients that will enhance their nutritional characteristics. The project started in November 2017 and has a duration of 36 months.
It also implements, in collaboration with the University of Ioannina, the ENVIAQUAMAN project, within the framework of the Epirus Regional Development Plan. The object of the project is the real time control of physicochemical parameters with the aim of protecting the environment and the certification of Pisces.
Implements in collaboration with ELKETHE, the AQUA -IoT project, an innovative application of smart IoT networks in the interconnection and transfer of environmental data and industrial applications for integrated coastal zone management at POA level "in the Fisheries Operational Program" 2014-2020 ".
Finally, the implementation of the PROGNOSIS project - "Correlation of Abiotic and Biotic Factors for the Development of a Disease Prognosis Model in Fish Farms", funded by the European Fisheries and Maritime Fund in the 2014 Operational Program 2020 ", in collaboration with ELGO - DIMITRA.

Kuipers Electronic Engineering BV was founded more than 40 years ago and is a family owned company with two main activities: TMX Smart Telecontrol and YES-Partner. These two main activities stem from a philosophy and passion to offer the best possible solutions for our clients technically as well as economically. All disciplines needed to achieve this can be found under one roof. Hard- and software development, production, testing, R&D, hosting services, consultancy, project management, sales & marketing and 24/7 support are all represented in our own organisation. Westrongly believe in the added value of having all these disciplines resulting in an end user focused approach and high standards when it comes to product quality en reliability.
Since we combine all these disciplines we can quickly respond to technology changes and customer demand. Having close connections with for example Delft University of Technology, TNO and being member of the Hague Security Delta (HSD) we’re in close contact with the latest developments and trends.
Under the brandname TMX Smart Telecontrol all activities concerning tele monitoring and tele control take place. TMX Smart Telecontrol has its own main station either web based (TMX-Net PRO) or on premise, its own substations (intelligent PLC’s) such as the LMX400 and LMX800-series. Anticipating on the latest development concerning communication technology such as NB IoT, LTE-M and LoRa, TMX developed an IoT platform called IMX. This IoT platform allows end users to implement an economically priced device which connects with a wide variety of sensors. With the use of the IMX, end users can implement large scale sensor grids which allows for data driven usage.
Also communication and hosting services in a datacenter can be offeredresulting in full end-to-end solutions for our clients.
Typically our clients can be found in critical infrastructure such as Water boards, Municipalities and other governmental organizations. High reliability and guaranteed uptimes are key here. But also the industry sector and for example large scale energy monitoring of domestic housing are markets we operate in. 
In the water sector, TMX holds a leading position with a proven track record for more than 30 years. In this sector guaranteed uptimes and high levels of security are key. Typically, clients in this sector have a full option TMX Main Station in their headquarters and many objects in their area which are connected via sub stations to the Main Station. These can vary from hundreds to thousands of objects and vary in complexity from simple groundwater logging to complex pumping stations were hundreds of parameters are logged every minute. From the Main Station each sub station can be managed resulting and reliable and secure operation and good total cost of ownership.
TMX has a culture of close collaboration with clients and end users resulting in products and services that are fit for purpose and are subject to constant evolution and optimization.

The INSTITUTE FOR RENEWABLE ENERGY conducts applied research on ADVANCED ENERGY SYSTEMS, based on or including SUSTAINABLE ENERGY SOURCES.

Its activities include NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH PROJECTS, as well as direct COOPERATION WITH INDUSTRY PARTNERS. Industry-related projects normally involve the development of new products and the evaluation of technological solutions. The Institute also supports the promotion of renewable energy technologies and assists political decision-makers the scientific consultancy.​​
The Institute's research involves the extensive use of DYNAMICSIMULATIONS and MULTIPHYSICS MODELLING of advanced energy systems and buildings.​​ Scientific results are based on LABORATORYTESTS of single components and integrated energy systems, as well as the MONITORING of applied demonstration sites, experimental outdoor installations and residential buildings. The Institute offers support also in the elaboration of COMPLEX ENERGY MODELS as DECISION SUPPORT SYSTEM for single energy systems or buildings as well as for urban and regional areas.

The Institute is structured into FIVE RESEARCH GROUPS:
SUSTAINABLE HEATING AND COOLING SYSTEMS​​ focusing on hybrid and efficient heating and cooling systems for buildings, industry and sustainable districts
PHOTOVOLTAIC ENERGY SYSTEMS​ focusing on the analysis of solar resources, performance and reliability of PV modules and systems and their integration into buildings and electricity grids
ENERGY EFFICIENT BUILDINGS​ focusing on energy flexible buildings, façade systems concepts, solutions for natural ventilation and daylighting, cost optimal solution-sets for NZEB with high IEQ​​
ENERGY RETROFIT OF HISTORIC BUILDINGS​​​ focusing on energy performance of historic buildings and districts, conservation aspects in retrofit solutions and energy planning​
URBAN AND REGIONAL ENERGY SYSTEMS​​​ focusing on sustainable energy planning, decision support system, ​big data frameworks, economic and financial evaluations of energy solutions​​

entityDescription:
Modern light weight construction can only happen if it is based on a reliable structural integrity. The current challenge is the validation of the component quality. Applied Validation of NDT is specialized in state-of-the-art evaluations for nondestructive testing methods. E.g. POD, ROC, and technical FMEAs based on modern concepts of multiparametric influences, complex relationships between complex defect structures and modern testing equipment. 
AV-NDT promote the probabilistic and structured evaluation of NDT systems due to a variety of projects together with industrial partners from energy sector, railway or automotive and due to scientific publications.

AV-NDT owns a large database on reliability evaluations of different methods, materials and testing systems. Furthermore, they have the access of a variety of different statistical software programs capable of calculating different kind of reliability results even for more complex multiparametric evaluations with sparse data. 
Dr. Daniel Kanzler is working for more than ten years in the field of reliability evaluation of non-destructive testing systems. He started his career at GE Sensing and Inspection Technologies in the field of ultrasonic testing with his diploma and his master thesis. Later he changed his job to the Federal Institute of Material Testing and Research, Berlin, into the department Radiology, where he finished his PhD 2016. Different publications, his diploma, master and PhD thesis considered different perspective of testing systems for the field of ultrasonic testing, radiographic testing, visual testing and eddy current testing. The probabilistic evaluation due to realistic defects with multiparametric influence analyses and the inclusion of economical KPIs was one of the accomplished goals. 
He has the NDT Master degree with certified three level 3 in ultrasonic, radiographic and eddy current testing (ISO 9712). Since 2012 he is lecturer of DGZfP (German Society of Non-destructive Testing), for different universities (e.g. at TU Munich and TH Aschaffenburg) and tutor for the European American Workshop on reliability of NDT. 
Since 2017 he is leading the ICNDT specialist group on NDT Reliability. Furthermore, he is reviewer on different international standards and scientific papers.
